summary: Pilot-only search 3: hyperparameter-randomized RF mixtures vs fixed configs, paired 3x5 CV
reasoning: The first locked procedure was honest (nested gap 0.024) but its all-500 RF missed the floor; diagnosis from pilot evidence: single-config trees overfit noise on 400 samples and inner tuning adds selection noise. Correction to test, still an RF on all 500 features with no screen: per-tree randomization of (max_features, min_samples_leaf) — mixtures rand8/rand12 — against the fixed winners (gini/entropy) and a bootstrap-off variant, all on identical 3x5 pilot folds, 1000 trees each. Heldout is not read. Predeclared decision rule: lock a mixture only if it beats the fixed winner by more than 2 paired SEs; otherwise keep the fixed config as the locked learner. Expected: the best model's pooled pilot-CV AUC >= 0.74 (comfortably above the floor), giving the corrected locked analysis for one final heldout scoring.
